note.ja: 同じ中性周期電荷・規約の収束したEwald和、力の有限差分とカットオフ・格子収束を確認します。孤立重力粒子の直接和とは境界・相互作用が異なります。 追加版は同じ中性8点電荷・立方体・tin-foil規約のエネルギーと全粒子力を、別実装theta積分と参照自身の細分化に照合します。SPMEはB-splineのエネルギー勾配型であり、原Lagrange PMEや厳密運動量保存を主張しません。
note.en: Check converged Ewald sums for identical neutral periodic charges/conventions, force finite differences and cutoff/mesh refinement. Boundaries and interactions differ from isolated gravitational direct sums. The companion compares energy and every force for the same neutral eight-charge cubic tin-foil cell against a separately implemented theta integral and its own refinement. SPME uses B-spline energy gradients; original Lagrange PME and exact momentum conservation are not claimed.
